statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail 11% sits in the low band, far below the 25% block threshold, while Stress 47% reflects a genuinely difficult macro backdrop.

headline: Nasdaq-100 closes at a record 31,076.44 on megacap strength; Tail low, Stress elevated with the 10-year near 5.31%.
body: The NDX cash session closed at a record 31,076.44, up 268.51 points (+0.87%) from a 30,807.93 previous close, with a 30,798.42-31,117.36 range that opened near the low and finished in the upper third. Nvidia reached an all-time high near $237 and megacap technology led the advance, extending Friday's rally after a weak September payrolls print of 29,000 pared back October rate-hike expectations. The advance occurred against bond weakness rather than with it: the 10-year rose 3bp to 5.31%, close to its highest since 2002, while the 2-year eased 2bp to 4.82% and the 5-year sat at 5.07%, leaving a steeper curve. VIX closed at 15.52 with its session low set near the cash close, and WTI fell 1.84% to $89.23 while Brent slipped 1.89% to $100.19. September ISM Services came in at 54.9 against a 55.0 consensus, with the prices component rising to 74.0. The Globex reopen after 22:00 UTC has printed a narrow NQ range near 41 points with no directional extension. The result is a directional cash uptrend without confirming cross-asset alignment, which the contract treats as a Stress and conviction question rather than evidence of mean-reversion failure, so Tail stays in the low band.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 published hours show Tail decaying from the mid-teens through the Asian and European sessions to a 6% low at 08:00 UTC, then rebuilding through the US cash session as megacap leadership firmed. The 19:00 UTC hour reached Tail 20% and the WATCH state during the late-session advance before easing to 17% and 14% after the cash close. Stress fell steadily from 66% to a 46% trough around midday and then rebuilt into the low fifties. Dominant mode rotated between normal, mixed and trend-up, with a single trend-down print at 10:00 UTC. The 06:00 UTC slot has no published assessment and stays explicitly unavailable.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours cover a catalyst-free overnight stretch, the European cash session, and the 06 Oct US cash session. Conditional Tail sits at its floor near 9% in the thinnest overnight liquidity, rises through the European open into the low teens, and peaks at 20% and the WATCH state for the 13:00 UTC hour containing the US cash open, where continuation from a record close near the session high is the main conditional checkpoint. It then decays through the US session before returning to the overnight floor during the Globex maintenance break. No forecast hour reaches the 25% block threshold. Stress stays in the elevated band throughout on an unchanged 5.31% 10-year, Brent above $100 and a hot ISM services prices component. Scheduled checkpoints beyond this horizon are the 07 Oct FOMC minutes and September CPI on 14 Oct.
